mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY emp41_seq) AS eval_write_id, emp41_eval_list_id AS eval_list_id, f_cdnm('EmpEvalClassCode', emp41_eval_class_cd, emp40_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS eval_class_nm, emp41_content AS content, emp41_weight_member AS weight_member, emp41_weight_leader AS weight_leader, emp42_grade AS eval_grade, emp44_eval_grade_id AS eval_grade_id, emp44_eval_grade_score AS eval_grade_score FROM emp41_eval_list INNER JOIN emp40_eval_list_std ON emp41_eval_list_std_id = emp40_eval_list_std_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp44_eval_write ON emp44_eval_list_id = emp41_eval_list_id AND emp44_eval_target_id = #{evalTargetId} AND emp44_evaluator_id = #{personId} LEFT OUTER JOIN emp42_eval_grade ON emp44_eval_grade_id = emp42_eval_grade_id WHERE emp41_eval_list_std_id = #{evalListStdId} ORDER BY emp41_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp44_eval_write (emp44_eval_write_id, emp44_evaluator_id, emp44_eval_target_id, emp44_eval_list_id, emp44_eval_grade_id, emp44_eval_grade_score) VALUES (#{evalWriteId}, #{personId}, #{evalTargetId}, #{evalListId}, #{evalGradeId}, (SELECT CASE WHEN #{orgHeadYn} = 'true' THEN emp41_weight_leader ELSE emp41_weight_member END FROM emp41_eval_list WHERE emp41_eval_list_id = #{evalListId}) * (SELECT emp42_grade_weight FROM emp42_eval_grade WHERE emp42_eval_grade_id = #{evalGradeId}))
